title: Harassment alleged in Plus Two student’s suicide; kin protest with body

ai.summary: Grieving relatives and students protested with a 17-year-old Plus Two student's body, alleging severe mental harassment by school authorities that led to his suicide.

facts.claim: Grieving relatives and students protested with the body of a 17-year-old Plus Two student
facts.quote: High drama and tense moments prevailed at the Sooranad Government Higher Secondary School on Monday as grieving relatives, local residents, and students staged a protest with the body of a 17-year-old Plus Two student, demanding strict legal action against the school authorities over allegations of severe mental harassment that drove him to suicide.

facts.claim: alleging severe mental harassment by school authorities that led to his suicide
facts.quote: The family has leveled grave allegations against the school administration, claiming that the principal and teachers humiliated Niranjan in front of other students simply for speaking to a female classmate.

ai.background_note: A 17-year-old Plus Two student died by suicide after alleged severe mental harassment by school authorities, prompting protests with his body.
